newsitem.title: JAPAN: Citibank to reduce fees for sending money abroad.
newsitem.headline: Citibank to reduce fees for sending money abroad.

text.p: Citibank N.A., a Japanese subsidiary of Citicorp, will reduce the fees its account-holding customers pay to send money abroad from May 1, a Citibank spokeswoman said.
The foreign-exchange commission of 2,500 yen for transfers of dollars abroad through either electronic transfers or bank checks will be eliminated, she added.
But other charges, including a basic 4,000 yen charge for electronic transfers and 2,800 yen for bank checks, will remain, she said.

The charge for issuing travellers' checks, currently one percent of the total issue amount, will also be waived from May 1, the spokeswoman added. This service will be limited to customers holding an account with Citibank, she said.
